response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), status_averages AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event_averages GROUP BY status), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM event_averages) SELECT s.status, s.avg_remaining, s.avg_overspend_rate, s.avg_remaining / NULLIF(o.avg_remaining, 0) AS remaining_ratio FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o;

assumptions.assumption: An overspend rate with a zero budget amount is undefined and is excluded from rate averages.
